description: Na₂ZrNi(P₂O₇)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.80 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.76 Å. Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.18 Å. Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one ZrO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.38 Å. There are four inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ZrO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NiO₆ octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-61°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.49-1.62 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NiO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-53°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.59 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NiO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-61°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.59 Å. In the fourth P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ZrO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NiO₆ octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-45°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.63 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Zr and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Zr, one Ni, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, one Ni, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Zr and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one P atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one P atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ni, and one P atom.
